name: Small Furry Paws
label: Quest
description: Small Furry Paws: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The first lesson in drawing a crowd is: lure them with gadgets and trinkets! Can you help me?
I need small furry paws to use for prizes. You can find those on the cats of the Barrens or Darkshore....
Bring me some paws and I'll trade you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you got them! We can use these to make toys and baubles, and those will attract more people to the Faire!
Here's your ticket, friend. You earned it!
